adjudication_trailer.SUMMARY: "120 strings adjudicated: 104 pass, 16 warn, 0 fail; every placeholder and HTML tag survived intact. Terminology drift: 'ingested' consistently back-translated as 'included' (9, 12, 13, 20, 54, 80); 'bean' as 'task' (15, 17); 'captured' as 'harvested' (70, 78); state badge 'referenced' as 'Reference only' (92); 'directory' as 'catalogue' (22, rated major because 'catalogue' is a distinct defined object here). Sense drift: repository 'size' as 'capacity' (5, 6, 7, 100); 'interpolated' as 'extrapolated' (100); 'not WHO' narrowed to 'not the WHO website' (12, 20). Not counted as drift: 'rendered' as 'generated' and 'held' as 'kept' (natural back-translations, consistent, sense preserved); singular/plural differences in column headings and badges (Bundle/Bundles, Item/Items, the WPRO item/items); 'State' as 'Status'; added politeness ('please run', 'Contact us'); explanatory expansions (KG as knowledge graph, WPRO spelled out, 'accessions' as accession dates); dropped spaces before placeholders; capitalisation of office names; minor synonyms (front door/entry page, mocks/imitates, asset/resource, egress-blocked/access prohibited, mark/logo, live/usable for non-greyed rows). Glossary terms 116-119 (certainty/quality of the evidence, confidence in the effect estimate, GRADE levels) were rendered correctly."
